models.note: DeepSeek's API docs: Use deepseek-flash as the model name. It is now served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and the calling method remains unchanged. The legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired; their requests are served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and billed at the Flash price. No retirement date is published.
